claim_limit: One fused GEMM+bias+exact-GELU+row-softmax shape. Ada performance claims require the frozen RTX 6000 Ada run; cross-architecture work is feasibility-only.

frozen_gate.timing_eligibility: Every launchable cell passes all 4 cases x 64 seeds x 2 gates before timing.

inference.selection_rule: Top two gate-legal screen cells plus g01 per strategy x lane, deduplicated.
inference.sham_publication_rule: On log-ratio scale, the floor is max(abs(log(CI endpoints))) across sham distributions. An effect is reportable only when its entire CI lies outside plus/minus that floor.
inference.support_rule: The cuda_noptx register and Triton explicit-smem paths remain unresolved until each has 19 retained probe outcomes. One gate-passing attempt establishes measured support; otherwise all failures must share a captured API/compiler limitation.

preregistration_policy: Resolve and seal both support probes, freeze all source/dependency hashes, commit, push, and verify the launch commit on its configured upstream before campaign GPU work.

strategy_contracts.global_intermediate: Lane-native GEMM writes fp32 global scratch; one common checked CUDA kernel performs bias, exact GELU, and row softmax.
strategy_contracts.register_fused: Bias and exact GELU are expressed directly on lane-native accumulator values before global store, with no explicit fp32 epilogue tile; compiler spills are retained descriptively. Lane-native softmax follows.
strategy_contracts.register_common_postprocess: Lane-native GBG applies bias and exact GELU directly to accumulator values without an explicit fp32 epilogue tile; one byte-identical common CUDA kernel performs only row softmax, and compiler spills are retained descriptively.
strategy_contracts.smem_staged: The accumulator tile is explicitly staged through per-block shared memory before bias and exact GELU, followed by the lane-native softmax.
